# Settings

Every Argus setting, as it appears in VS Code's Settings and on the Control Center's
[Settings tab](features/control-center.md#settings-tab). Settings work at user or workspace level.

## Sessions board

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.sessions.prRefreshMinutes` | `1` | How often PR states refresh in the background, for session cards. |
| `argus.sessions.retentionDays` | `30` | Session record files for sessions that are no longer open are deleted once they have not been updated for this many days. |
| `argus.sessions.scope` | `"window"` | Which sessions this VS Code window shows. Set it in Workspace settings to choose per window. With no folder open, all sessions are shown.<br>`window`: Only show sessions whose folder, or git repo and worktrees, belongs to this window's workspace folders.<br>`folder`: Only show sessions whose folder (or a linked worktree) is inside this window's workspace folders; other folders of the same git repo are left out.<br>`all`: Show every Claude Code session on this machine in every window. |

## Notifications

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.notifications` | `"all"` | Show a VS Code notification, with a button to open the session, when a Claude Code session in this window starts waiting on you.<br>`all`: Notify when a session needs permission, asks a question, or finishes.<br>`input`: Only when a session needs permission or asks a question.<br>`off`: No notifications. |

## Pull requests

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.prs.cacheSeconds` | `300` | How long a fetched PR state is reused before gh is called again, in seconds. |

## Chat

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.chat.claudePath` | `""` | Path to the `claude` executable Argus chat runs. Empty: `claude` on your PATH, then `~/.local/bin`, where Claude Code's installer puts it. **Argus: Install or Update Claude Code** installs it. |
| `argus.chat.askForFolder` | `false` | In a window with several workspace folders, ask which folder each new Argus chat starts in. Off: new chats start in the first workspace folder, like the Claude Code extension. |
| `argus.chat.experimentalMultiAgent` | `false` | Experiment: several agents on one task, shown side by side in one tab. Adds **+** (new or existing agent) and opening a group's card as a grid. Off: forks open in their own tab. |
| `argus.chat.textOnlyDefault` | `false` | Open chats in Text only view (your messages and Claude's replies, tool calls hidden). The Text only button in a chat still switches it, and each chat remembers its own choice. |
| `argus.chat.hiddenModels` | `[]` | Models to leave out of the chat's model picker, by name as shown (e.g. `Haiku 4.5`) or id (e.g. `claude-opus-4-6`, `haiku`). A chat's current model always stays listed. Applies to chats opened after the change. |
| `argus.chat.backgroundIdleMinutes` | `60` | How long a chat with no open tab keeps its Claude process after it goes idle. While it runs, other agents can message it and its timers keep firing. A chat that is working or waiting on you is never stopped. `0` stops it as soon as its turn ends. |

## Diff review

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.diffReview.baseRef` | `""` | Base to diff against. Empty uses origin/HEAD, then origin/main, origin/master, main, master. |
| `argus.diffReview.contextLines` | `3` | Unchanged lines shown around each change in the diff review. |

## Plan usage

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.usage.enabled` | `true` | Show Claude plan usage in the status bar. Reads the sign-in Claude Code stores on this machine (`~/.claude/.credentials.json`, or the macOS keychain) and sends it only to Anthropic's undocumented usage endpoint (`api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage`). On by default; turn off to stop reading the sign-in. |
| `argus.usage.refreshMinutes` | `5` | How often Claude plan usage refreshes in the background. |

## Keep awake

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.keepAwake.mode` | `"off"` | Stop this machine sleeping. Uses a Windows power request, caffeinate on macOS, or systemd-inhibit on Linux. Closing the lid still sleeps it. Change it from the Awake button in the chat header or the status bar.<br>`off`: Let this machine sleep as normal.<br>`on`: Keep this machine awake until you turn it off, whatever the agents are doing.<br>`auto`: Keep this machine awake while any Claude session in this window is working or scheduled, and for 2 minutes after. |
| `argus.keepAwake.whileAgentsRun` | `false` | **Deprecated.** Use argus.keepAwake.mode. When mode isn't set, true here means auto. |
| `argus.keepAwake.keepScreenOn` | `true` | While keeping the machine awake, keep the screen on too. Needed on Windows laptops with Modern Standby, which go to sleep when the screen turns off. |

## Plugins

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argus.plugins.paths` | `[]` | Extra plugin folders to load, on top of every folder in `~/.claude/argus/plugins`. Each entry is one plugin folder containing an `argus-plugin.json`. Use it to run a plugin straight from a git checkout. `~` is expanded. |
| `argus.plugins.config` | `{}` | Settings for locally installed Argus plugins, keyed by plugin id: `"argus.plugins.config": { "my-plugin": { "someSetting": "value" } }`. A plugin's README should list its keys. User and workspace scopes are merged key by key. |
